name: DonWeb Cloud Servers
line: Rent virtual servers with configurable compute, storage, and transfer.

free.text: No recurring free Cloud Server plan

work.math: The promotional monthly price includes IVA (value-added tax). 100 GB of data sent out fits the 1 TB allowance. Build performance is untested.
The 1 vCPU and 1 GB VM includes 1 TB of transfer. The promotion includes IVA (value-added tax), but the vendor recommends 2 vCPU and 2 GB for app stacks.
2 × ARS 9,708.67 = ARS 19,417.34 a month, including IVA. The price of seven-day Premium Daily backups is not published.
